messages.body: Assignment: You own implementation only. Create the Next.js app under the repository root, shared exact Decimal calculation core, and Japanese quotation UI. Do not edit test files except fixing direct build errors. Read the context file and design sections 2,3,4,5,6,7,8. Report files and evidence via mailbox, then transition task 1 completed.
Verification lane ready. Please send me the core/UI paths as soon as they are stable; I will add unit/browser coverage without touching implementation except minimal direct test fixes.

Review finding (must fix): calculatePouchCost invokes validateDigitalFilmOrder but ignores digitalValidation.valid; API can return 200 for total<500m or SKU<300m. calculateFilmCost also computes one quantity-derived length instead of using validated SKU order lengths. Please enforce structured rejection and cover POST invalid cases.
